status: local development; production publication requires fresh confirmation

business_decisions.plans: Keep Free and Pro; do not add a third plan or change prices and device quotas in this round.
business_decisions.upsell_principle: Explain existing paid benefits when the user needs them; never claim guaranteed mining returns.

parity_contract: Validated multiple identifiers persist in the existing user-owned fleet database and survive sign-in and refresh.
A payout account may contain many pool worker records; workers are not automatically saved as physical devices or charged against the quota.
Current metrics distinguish null, zero, errors, stale data and not-found records.
Cards and lists have consistent semantic status colors, search and filtering, and usable mobile layouts.
Preserve each source's reward period and currency units; do not relabel rolling 24h as IOTA yesterday.
Only render genuine supported history; no fabricated trend or zero-filled missing time.
Every supported project has a discoverable monitor, specific problem-oriented guide, source links and five-language metadata.
Visible text, FAQ structured data, Markdown exports and static crawl assets agree.

first_delivery.task: Shared pool worker cards and filtering
first_delivery.scope: All existing generic pool pages; keep BNT dashboard intact
Monitor, fleet persistence migration, aggregation and validation
Find remaining gaps before claiming complete IOTA parity

new_project_evidence.scope: Public normal 2Miners pools only; not whole networks or SOLO. Snapshot counts are workers, not unique people or physical machines.
